name: from_raw
declaration: unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self
rules: The pointer passed to Weak::from_raw must have originated from a previous call to Weak::into_raw.
The pointer passed to Weak::from_raw must still own its potential weak reference; pointers created by Weak::new do not own a weak reference.
The pointer passed to Weak::from_raw must point to a block of memory allocated by the global allocator.
